ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with high-intensity (white/cream) pixels covering approximately 15% of the visible fluke, primarily at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patches at the distal ends of both lobes. The left lobe patch is solid and occupies the outer tip; the right lobe patch is mottled with black pixel incursions. Small punctate white flecks are visible along the medial-inferior trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped notch with an acute interior angle estimated at 45-55 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with maximum amplitude on the lateral thirds of the trailing edge; the edge topography becomes more rounded and lower in amplitude as it approaches the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct concave curve along the trailing edge from the notch to the tips, flaring outward laterally.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A cluster of approximately 6-8 circular high-intensity white spots (consistent with barnacle attachment) located on the lateral-most edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, multi-vector light-colored linear scratches visible against the dark pigment on the interior surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical calcifications on the far left fluke tip and multiple superficial linear rake marks across the right lobe pigmentation.
